messages:
Marco: Hey folks — quick availability check. Need 8x A100 (40GB) in us-west2 for a 3h demo load test next Tue 10am PST. Can procurement/vendor confirm if we can reserve or borrow from standby? Pref reserved but can do ephemeral. Also need RDMA.
Alice-Vendor: Hi Marco — checking inventory now. Looks like we can guarantee 6 immediately, 2 pending returns late morning. If you can shift the window to 10:30-13:30 the chance of full 8 increases. Will confirm ETA on PR today.
Sasha: If vendor can confirm today I can fast-track the PO. Marco — please paste billing center tag and project id so I can attach.
Marco: project: redwood-inference-demo
Marco: billing_center: infra-demos
Marco: Terraform snippet for clarity:
```
resource "gpu_reservation" "demo" {
  region = "us-west2"
  type = "a100-40gb"
  count = 8
  duration_hours = 3
}
```
Raj: Quick quota check — our cloud quota shows only 6 A100s available in us-west2 right now. For a reserved endpoint we'll need a quota bump unless vendor provides managed reserved capacity. @Sasha can you kick the quota request if needed?
Sasha: I can submit a quota bump but prefer vendor reservation to avoid cloud-side delays. I'll open the PO and attach the invoice once Alice confirms. Also please add tag `env:demo` and `team:infra` to the billing.
Alice-Vendor: Update — portal shows 2 scheduled returns Tue 09:30. If you pick 10:30-13:30 we can swap and guarantee 8. Sending reservation link: https://vendor.example/reserve/abc123
Marco: I can shift to 10:30-13:30, that works. Taking the reservation link now. One thing — we need RoCE / low-latency networking enabled for the canary; can vendor ensure RDMA? 
Alice-Vendor: Yes, RDMA available on that rack. I'll mark the reservation with `rdma:yes`.
DeployBot: Reservation abc123 created by Alice-Vendor for project redwood-inference-demo, status: pending-approval. (id=abc123)
Sasha: Approved on our side, submitting PO now. @Raj please confirm the TF var names so I attach the right cost center.
Raj: Confirmed. I'll update tfvars and open PR: https://git.example/r/infra/PR-321 — will add tags `env:demo` and `billing:infra-demos`.
Marco: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll follow up in the ticket and attach canary smoke test instructions and expected perf targets (p95 < 150ms).
